senses.gloss:
न॑हन n. binding, tying round;
 bond, fetter, bolt.
नहि॑ (न॑ हि॑) adv. indeed not, by no means, not at all.
1 ना॑हुष f. ई belonging to the same race, kin.

2 नाहुष m. descendant of Nahuṣa, patr. of Yayāti, N. of a
serpent-demon.

नहुष्य॑ a. belonging to or descendent of Nahuṣa, human
i.g.

न॑हुस् m. race, lineage, tribe;
 neighbour, comrade, friend.
